en: A color illustration of a large black and yellow ocean liner with two tall black smokestacks, identified as the P. & O. steamship 'Malwa', anchored off a tropical port. Smaller sailboats and rowboats filled with people surround the ship on vibrant blue water. In the background is a palm-lined waterfront with colonial-style buildings and a clock or bell tower, suggesting a busy harbor scene at Colombo.
